name: Kogen
description: Kogen builds software features from an approved Intent through implementation, checks, independent review and a commit.
whenToUse: Start at https://kogen.dev/get-started/ to install Kogen, sign in, initialise a Git repository and build a feature. Use an agent interface with command-line access to run Kogen intent shape and refine, show the Intent for approval, approve its exact hash when authorised, then run Kogen intent build and wait for the result. Make the implementation through Kogen. Hand private provider login to the user. Public HTML pages offer Markdown through Accept: text/markdown and linked .md copies. Use the sitemap to find canonical pages, Notes and announcements.
